macros.name: absval
macros.doc: gives absolute value of a number or a dimension (if in a dimension register).

macros.name: clearevenpage
macros.doc: \clearoddpage and \clearevenpage are the same as \newoddpage and \newevenpage, except they call \clearpage first, causing all unprocessed floats to be written out.

macros.name: clearoddpage
macros.doc: \clearoddpage and \clearevenpage are the same as \newoddpage and \newevenpage, except they call \clearpage first, causing all unprocessed floats to be written out.

macros.name: clearthispage
macros.doc: \clearthispage writes out all unprocessed floats, and starts a new page regardless of whether the current page is empty.

macros.name: ddmonthyyyy
macros.doc: Regardless of what \today happens to be defined as, \ddmonthyyyy gives a format of 15 July 2004.

macros.name: degree
macros.doc: Because \degree clashes with many thesis packages, lhelp will define both \degree and \Degree to be the degree symbol (superscript circle), if they are not defined already by the time lhelp is loaded.

macros.name: Discuss
macros.doc: Place a visible sign that a text passage needs to be further discussed or edited.

macros.name: draftfont

macros.name: draftname
macros.doc: \draftname produces the “DRAFT” text.

macros.name: Edit

macros.name: EPSfileext

macros.name: listshort
macros.doc: \listshort sets all vertical spacing to zero: \topsep, \partopsep, \itemsep and \parsep.

macros.name: Mark
macros.doc: Place a visible mark in the text to mark something which is not yet finished.

macros.name: minlinelen
macros.doc: There is a length parameter, \minlinelen, that sets a minimum length for the lines of text.

macros.name: newoddpage*

macros.name: notesfont
macros.doc: If any notes are printed, they are printed in \notesfont.

macros.name: putdraftmarkps

macros.doc: \setTBstruts defines two macros, \T and \B, which fine-tune the vertical spacing on these lines.

macros.name: thinthinspace
macros.doc: Approximately half a thinspace.

macros.name: timehhmm
macros.doc: The current time is put into \timehhmm formatted as HH:MM with leading 0.

macros.name: todayaddtime
macros.doc: \todayaddtime appends the time to the definition of \today, which is useful if something else has redefined \today.

macros.name: ulbf
macros.doc: Quick and dirty underline, underline bold, and lineout.

macros.name: vnul
macros.doc: An empty \vbox right at the top edge of the page.

macros.name: yyyymmdd
macros.doc: Regardless of what \today happens to be defined as, \yyyymmdd gives a format of 2004/7/15.

envs.name: narrowpars
envs.doc: The narrowpars environment temporarily narrows the width of the text body, respectively increases the left and right margins.
